incomplete_fix_quote: The RocketMQ NameServer component still has a remote command execution vulnerability as the CVE-2023-33246 issue was not completely fixed in version 5.1.1. The nameserver UPDATE_NAMESRV_CONFIG handler in 5.1.1 blocklists 'kvConfigPath' and 'configStorePathName', but the actual dangerous NamesrvConfig property is 'configStorePath' (not 'configStorePathName'). Setting configStorePath via the remoting protocol redirects where the nameserver config is persisted, enabling arbitrary file write.
root_cause_detail: Typo/wrong-name in the 5.1.1 blocklist: 'configStorePathName' (non-existent property) was blocked instead of 'configStorePath' (the real NamesrvConfig field). The 5.1.2 fix corrects the blocklist to check 'configStorePath'.
